Worth auditing testid naming for consistency — buttons should have stable testids so future regression scripts can target them (e.g., results-nav-jump-script, results-nav-copy-script). NOT blocking.

Implementation detail: SectionCard hides its body via conditional rendering (unmount) rather than the .section-card.is-collapsed .section-card-body { display:none } CSS rule the iter_13 spec referenced. Both achieve the same visual outcome; the unmount approach actually saves DOM weight. The CSS rule is therefore dead code if it exists — worth a sweep.

rca of the issue: ALREADY FIXED. Original RCA (iter_13): toggleCollapseAll used `visibleSectionKeys.every(k => prev.has(k))` which returns vacuous-true when visibleSectionKeys is []; result was always `new Set()`, making the button feel dead. Fix applied at Scripts.jsx:167-178: (a) early-return guard `if (visibleSectionKeys.length === 0) return;` at top of the handler, (b) wrapped handler in useCallback with [visibleSectionKeys] dependency so the closure always sees the freshest array. Both defences are now in place; verified by iter_14 click1/click2 cycle on 7-section long-form output.
